cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

mechanism: Copy a windowsill pot's position as permission for a plant, then exploit B's small concession and its stated reason to claim a second plant.
confusable: Not a simple expansion of a request: the copied object's different function must be corrected, and A must use the actual concession's logic.
comparison: Plant drying and shared sunlight instead of a speech paragraph and authorship.
seedUse: Retains one plant on a sill as foothold for more; adds empty pot drying mistaken for approved living display.
